rules: No Library project or example is selected automatically.
Story values are empty while schemas, Learn taxonomy and creation capability remain available.
The first explicit Save requests a project name and creates a fresh durable Library identity.
Unsaved agent proposals may remain runtime-local without silently creating a project.
Afterglow loads only after an explicit Library action.
The packaged example carries approved story values and repository-backed resources.
Profile-local Afterglow changes remain a separate explicit restore mode.
Example assets must not use data:, file:, or /api/local-ai/assets/ URLs.

currentApprovedSignals: Theme and tone signals used by World Map projection
Character Truth including Ren, Amy and Summer/Isobel
afterglowMigration.unresolvedRule: If the current approved package has no value in a migration-candidate domain, keep the blank/example field empty rather than manufacture story content.

surfaceBehavior.mindMap: Blank opens with an empty detached project; Human can create immediately; first explicit save establishes identity.
surfaceBehavior.worldMap: Blank opens as an empty read/review projection; current legacy authoring controls must establish identity before any save.
surfaceBehavior.libraryNew: Creates the same empty project shape with a durable identity immediately.
surfaceBehavior.libraryExample: Explicitly opens the canonical packaged Afterglow working copy.

futureBoundary: Phase 3/4 will unify the full Learn field model and move creation controls to Mind Map. Phase 2 changes entry/data ownership only.
